description: Discover what a dataset accepts: its dimension names in key order, and the codes available for each, filtered by `query`. Use this before get_data — e.g. search_indicators({dataset:"CPI", query:"united states"}) finds COUNTRY=USA. Without a query it returns the dimension list and a sample of codes.

query.description: Optional term matched against code ids and names, e.g. "united states", "GDP", "monthly".

name: search_indicators
